title: Reading Drill — Choosing a floor surface for a playgroup — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Choosing a floor surface for a playgroup — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The playgroup staff in Brackenton received an old report about moveable toys scratching some parts of a floor. The report compared the area with permanent marks, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the dated photographs rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered eight weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include variation in toy weight. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed additional mats under storage as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
